title: Evening digest: red alert in 5 TS districts, SC CEC split, Charminar plaster, KAVACH 4.0, Mirabai silver
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Siasat / Telangana Today / Newsmeter / NewsMill
verified_by: Azad Daily desk (multi-outlet cross-check: Hindu+Newsmeter, Siasat+Hindu, Siasat+TelanganaTribune, NM+NewsMill+RailPost, Hindu+TT)
bullets_en: Five Telangana districts placed under red alert for very heavy rain on September 24.
Supreme Court bench split on CEC appointment law refers the case to Chief Justice.
Portion of Charminar plaster peels off after heavy rain; officials cordon off the area.
KAVACH 4.0 train protection system commissioned on Malkajgiri-Kamareddi section, first in SCR.
Mirabai Chanu wins silver at Asian Games and sets her sights on LA Olympics.
bullets_ur: Telangana ke panch districts mein 24 Sep ko bhaari barish ka red alert jaari kiya gaya.
Supreme Court ka bench CEC taqarruri qanoon par mutafarriq raha, mamla CJI ko bheja gaya.
Bhaari barish ke baad Charminar ke plaster ka hissa gir gaya, ohdedaron ne ilaqa gher liya.
Malkajgiri-Kamareddi par KAVACH 4.0 train protection system shuru, SCR mein pehli baar.
Mirabai Chanu ne Asian Games mein silver jeeta, ab LA Olympics par nazar hai.
